cover_highlight: A logistics-heavy spring week steadied by familiar dinners, Coachella-sparked album pairings, and a Saturday four-pie pizza night with Patrick visiting.

days.calendar: Laura out of town, Dan solo parent duty
calendar_items: Laura out of town, Dan solo parent duty

days.dinner: Leftover Sunday Gravy Rigatoni with Meatballs & Sausage
days.dinner_description: A family-style red-sauce pasta built around leftover gravy, sturdy rigatoni, meatballs, sausage, and pecorino Romano. It is planned around this week's timing, the family preferences, and a kid-friendly path to the table.
days.dinner_notes: Use leftover gravy; loosen with pasta water and finish the pasta in the sauce.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: See the nutrition section for how lunches and snacks balance this dinner.
days.album_description: A Coachella 2026 act pick with New York swagger, clipped guitars, and sharply drawn mini-scenes that make red-sauce Sunday feel like a little city movie.
days.album_sonic_description: Dry drums, interlocking downstroke guitars, laconic vocals, and lean bass lines with no wasted motion.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Leftover Sunday Gravy Rigatoni with Meatballs & Sausage gets this pairing because The Strokes bring downtown snap to a cozy Italian-American leftover night, keeping the meal from getting sleepy.
days.activity_notes: Cloudy solo-parent Sunday: keep the evening predictable and warm.
prep_notes: Check how much gravy is left before boiling pasta.
Prep Babo pasta components for Tuesday if time allows.

days.album_pairing_rationale: Wagyu Ultra-Smashed Cheeseburgers with Pickles & Secret Sauce gets this pairing because Smash burgers want speed, sizzle, and joy; Turnstile sounds like the griddle at full heat.
days.activity_notes: Let Elsie build her own burger so the meal feels playful instead of rushed.
prep_notes: Mix burger sauce earlier in the day.
Wash lettuce and slice pickles before cooking.

days.dinner: Babo Pasta: Egg-Yolk Spinach Tagliatelle with Brown Butter & Parm
days.dinner_description: Egg-yolk pasta is all silk and richness, and spinach gives the tagliatelle that deep green color. Brown butter and Parmigiano-Reggiano keep it simple enough that the handmade noodles stay the point.
days.dinner_notes: Prep the dough or at least stage the pasta tools before swim; brown the butter only when everyone is home.

days.album: Little Simz - Sometimes I Might Be Introvert
days.album_description: Little Simz’s 2021 Sometimes I Might Be Introvert won the Mercury Prize by making private reflection feel orchestral and bold. It has the sweep of a film score and the intimacy of a journal.
days.album_sonic_description: Orchestral swells, crisp drums, choral voices, deep bass, and precise rapping that moves like a stage monologue with a rhythm section.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Handmade pasta rewards attention; Little Simz turns that same inward focus into something grand.
days.activity_notes: Make the dough or stage ingredients before swim; keep Elsie's job small and satisfying.
prep_notes: Buy extra eggs for yolk-only dough.
Cook spinach dry enough that the dough does not turn sticky.
Stage flour, semolina, and the pasta tools before swim.

days.dinner: Slow-Cooked Pork Chops with Mushroom Cream Sauce
days.dinner_description: Tender slow-cooked pork chops finished with a silky mushroom cream sauce, thyme, garlic, Dijon mustard, and pan juices. It is planned around this week's timing, the family preferences, and a kid-friendly path to the table.
days.dinner_notes: Adapt to slow cooker so the chops stay tender. Keep mushrooms with cream and herbs; no roasted red peppers.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: See the nutrition section for how lunches and snacks balance this dinner.
days.album_description: A Coachella 2026 artist pick with sleek late-night grooves and intimate stories about longing, identity, and trying to stay soft in a hard city.
days.album_sonic_description: Slinky bass, glassy synths, clipped funk guitar, saxophone haze, and feather-light vocals.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Slow-Cooked Pork Chops with Mushroom Cream Sauce gets this pairing because The mushroom cream sauce is rich and soft; Blood Orange gives the rainy night a graceful pulse.
days.activity_notes: A good night for everyone to come back under one roof.
prep_notes: Season pork chops the night before.

time_constraints: Dan on call; make-ahead cabbage rolls keep a drizzly night calm and reheat-friendly.
days.dinner_description: Stuffed cabbage rolls show up across Eastern European and Jewish kitchens because they are thrifty, tender, and built for feeding people well. This version leans sweet-savory, with cabbage leaves wrapping a plush beef-and-rice filling.
days.dinner_notes: Make ahead or assemble earlier; reheat gently with extra sauce so the rolls stay tender.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: See the nutrition section for how lunches and snacks balance this dinner.
days.album_mood: Warm, theatrical, streetwise, and sing-along friendly.
days.album_description: Billy Joel’s 1977 The Stranger, produced by Phil Ramone, is full of booth-at-the-diner characters and piano hooks. It invites stories instead of disappearing into the background.
days.album_sonic_description: Piano-led pop rock with saxophone hooks, brisk drums, Broadway flair, and tight late-70s studio polish.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Cabbage rolls and Billy Joel both feel like someone at the table has a story to tell.
days.activity_notes: Serve the rolls warm and saucy, then keep the evening simple and early.
prep_notes: Blanch cabbage leaves and mix filling ahead.
Reheat covered with extra sauce so the rolls stay tender.

days.name: Fri 05/01
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (76% sunshine), wind 10 mph with gusts up to 27 mph, 18% precip
time_constraints: Friday can support a bright fish dinner if the on-call queue stays quiet.
days.dinner: Greek-Style Roasted Branzino with Garlicky Kale
days.dinner_description: Branzino is a Mediterranean sea bass that loves whole roasting with olive oil, herbs, and decisive heat. Ladolemono—Greek lemon and olive oil sauce—ties the fish to garlicky kale and wakes up the plate.
days.dinner_notes: Keep it bright and simple; the fish balances the week's red meat and dairy.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: See the nutrition section for how lunches and snacks balance this dinner.
days.album_description: Karol G’s 2023 Mañana Será Bonito turns recovery into color, movement, and big melodic confidence. Its reggaeton-pop brightness keeps the drizzle from setting the tone.
days.album_sonic_description: Reggaeton bounce, Caribbean percussion, glossy pop choruses, acoustic color, and warm low-end movement.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Lemon, herbs, and kale ask for lift; Karol G supplies sunshine without forcing cheer.
days.activity_notes: Let Elsie help whisk the lemon-olive oil sauce or season her own small fish flake.
prep_notes: Ask the fishmonger to clean the branzino.
Whisk the ladolemono just before serving.

days.dinner_description: A visitor-night pizza spread with four assorted pies, including a spring shaved asparagus white pizza plus family-friendly classics. It is planned around this week's timing, the family preferences, and a kid-friendly path to the table.

days.dinner_nutrition_notes: See the nutrition section for how lunches and snacks balance this dinner.
days.album_description: A Coachella 2026 act pick built for a room with guests, bubbling cheese, and people drifting between the kitchen and the table.
days.album_sonic_description: Four-on-the-floor drums, clipped vocal samples, rubbery bass, Afro-house percussion, and glossy festival-scale hooks.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Pizza Night: Four Assorted Pies gets this pairing because Four pizzas and a visitor call for momentum; Disclosure keeps the kitchen moving without drowning out conversation.
days.activity_notes: Sunny visitor Saturday: keep toppings modular and let everyone claim a pie.
prep_notes: Make or buy enough dough for four pies.
Stage toppings in bowls before baking.
Keep mushrooms and roasted red peppers separated.

appetizers.name: Labneh with Radishes, Olive Oil & Spring Herbs
appetizers.description: Thick strained yogurt spread on a plate and topped with crisp radishes, mint, dill, za'atar, lemon zest, and a glossy pour of olive oil.
appetizers.why: Fresh, easy, and seasonal; it can start the falafel, branzino, or pizza meals without being heavy.

appetizers.name: Artichoke Crostini with Lemon, Parmesan & Mint
appetizers.description: Toasty baguette slices topped with chopped artichokes, lemon, Parmesan, herbs, and olive oil for a bright aperitivo-style starter.
appetizers.why: A low-effort Italian appetizer that plays well with red sauce pasta, Babo Pasta, or pizza and uses spring's artichoke mood even if using jarred hearts.

salads.name: Spring Nicoise Platter with Asparagus, New Potatoes & Jammy Eggs
salads.description: A dinner-sized composed platter of spring greens, asparagus, new potatoes, radishes, jammy eggs, olives, capers, and optional tuna arranged in tidy sections rather than tossed.
salads.dressing: Dijon-shallot vinaigrette: whisk 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard, 1 small minced shallot, 1 teaspoon honey, 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper; stream in 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil until emulsified, then stir in 1 tablespoon chopped capers.
salads.flavor_rationale: This works because the rich eggs and potatoes need sharp acid, while asparagus and radishes bring snap and green bitterness. Olives and capers supply briny punctuation so the salad feels like a real dinner instead of a plate of vegetables.
salads.seasonal_note: Asparagus, radishes, spring greens, and new potatoes are all strong East Coast late-April/early-May choices; local eggs make it more substantial.
salads.why: Composed dinner salad: beautiful enough for company, substantial enough for a no-cook-ish dinner, and aligned with the week's spring produce.

salads.name: Spring Chickpea Fattoush with Snap Peas & Crispy Pita
salads.description: A generous tossed fattoush bulked up with chickpeas, romaine, cucumbers, radishes, snap peas, herbs, and shards of toasted pita.
salads.dressing: Lemon-sumac pomegranate dressing: whisk 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice, 1 tablespoon pomegranate molasses, 1 grated garlic clove, 1 teaspoon ground sumac, 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper; stream in 1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil and toss immediately with the salad.
salads.flavor_rationale: Fattoush is all about contrast: juicy vegetables, crisp pita, creamy chickpeas, and a tart dressing that wakes everything up. Sumac and pomegranate molasses echo the Middle Eastern dinner option while the chickpeas make the bowl filling enough to stand alone.
salads.seasonal_note: Radishes, tender lettuces, herbs, and snap peas are ideal late-spring Mid-Atlantic produce; cucumbers are acceptable as a crisp bridge into warmer weather.
salads.why: Tossed dinner salad: vegetarian-friendly, high-crunch, and a natural partner for falafel, branzino, or burgers.

salads.name: Asparagus, Radish & Sweet Pea Side Salad with Avocado-Herb Dressing
salads.description: A crisp green side salad of shaved asparagus, sliced radishes, sweet peas, herbs, and feta over tender lettuces.
salads.dressing: Avocado-herb dressing: blend 1 ripe avocado, 3 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1 small garlic clove, 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil, 2 tablespoons water, 1/4 cup parsley, 2 tablespoons dill, 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, and black pepper to taste.
salads.flavor_rationale: The creamy avocado dressing softens asparagus' grassy edge and gives lean spring vegetables enough body to sit beside burgers, pork chops, or fish. Lemon and herbs keep it bright so it does not fight creamy mushroom sauce or rich cheese.
salads.seasonal_note: Asparagus, radishes, peas, dill, parsley, and tender lettuces are exactly the produce to chase on the East Coast as April turns into May.
salads.why: Side salad #1: a spring-green counterweight for the heavier requested dinners.

salads.name: Butter Lettuce, Strawberries & Pickled Shallot Salad
salads.description: Soft butter lettuce, early strawberries, cucumber, toasted almonds, goat cheese, mint, and quick-pickled shallots in a poppy seed vinaigrette.
salads.dressing: Lemon-poppy seed vinaigrette: shake 3 tablespoons champagne vinegar, 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice, 1 tablespoon honey, 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard, 1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil, 1 teaspoon poppy seeds, 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper until glossy.
salads.flavor_rationale: Sweet strawberries and honey need the bite of pickled shallot and lemony acid to avoid tasting like dessert. Almonds add crunch, goat cheese adds tangy fat, and mint makes the whole salad feel cool next to pizza or spicy jambalaya.
salads.seasonal_note: Butter lettuce and herbs are abundant in late April; the first Mid-Atlantic strawberries often appear around early May, and supermarket berries can stand in if local fruit lags.
salads.why: Side salad #2: lighter, fruitier, and completely different from the asparagus-pea salad.

beverages.name: Chianti Classico or Other Sangiovese
beverages.description: A medium-bodied, high-acid Italian red with cherry, tomato, herb, and savory notes.
beverages.pairing_note: Best with Sunday gravy pasta, pizza, stuffed cabbage, and burgers because the acidity cuts tomato, fat, and cheese.
beverages.why: Pairing note: high acidity and savory tomato-friendly flavors make this the red wine workhorse for the Italian-American options.

beverages.name: Gruner Veltliner
beverages.description: A lean Austrian white with citrus, green apple, white pepper, and herbaceous snap.
beverages.pairing_note: Best with branzino, asparagus pizza, spring salads, and pork chops because it handles green vegetables and creamy sauces.
beverages.why: Pairing note: peppery acidity is especially useful for asparagus, kale, lemon, and mushroom cream.

beverages.name: Sparkling Strawberry-Basil Lemonade
beverages.description: A family-friendly pitcher drink: strawberry lemonade topped with sparkling water and slapped basil leaves for aroma.
beverages.pairing_note: Best with pizza, burgers, falafel, jambalaya, and the strawberry salad; add extra sparkling water for a lighter dinner drink.
beverages.why: Pairing note: tart lemon and bubbles refresh the palate across spicy, cheesy, and fried foods while staying kid-friendly.

Beverages: strawberries and lemons for sparkling strawberry-basil lemonade

Monday: mix burger sauce, wash lettuce, and slice pickles before the late meeting.
Monday night: stage Babo Pasta tools or make the spinach dough if time allows.
Tuesday: keep Babo Pasta components ready before swim and brown butter after everyone is home.
Tuesday night: season pork chops and slice mushrooms for Wednesday.
Wednesday: start pork chops early in the slow cooker; keep roasted red peppers away from mushrooms.
Wednesday night or Thursday morning: blanch cabbage leaves or assemble stuffed cabbage rolls.
Thursday: reheat cabbage rolls gently with extra sauce.
Friday: ask the fishmonger to clean branzino and wash kale.
Saturday: stage four pizza toppings in separate bowls and keep mushrooms separate from roasted red peppers.
